Description.Name: Habitats Galore!
Description.Details: While sitting at your desk, an alert chimes letting you know you have an incoming message from Habitats Galore. You click the message to display the content: "Greetings Commander {COMMANDER.LastName} and thank you for contacting Habitats Galore! Here at Habitats Galore!, we are proud to offer a selection of suitable upgrades, renovations and fitouts to suit all professions across a wide class of dropships and other planetary transport ships. Your initial enquiry states you are wanting to see about the possibility of upgrading one of the habitat pods on an Argo Class DropShip. As this is a Boeing Interstellar design, of which we are a subsidiary company, we would be happy to come to you for your assessment. The Assessment costs ¢100,000 and covers travel for our representative to you in orbit and their time outlining what we can do to make one of your non-functional areas into a suitable Habitation Pod. You may choose to accept the quote once it's provided or withdraw your interest for 90% refund of the consultation costs. Please select your choice below:"

Description.Name: Maybe another day...
Description.Details: You reread the message a few times before making up your mind and hitting the <color=#FF9500>DECLINE</color> button. You file the message for later when you have more time.  For now, there are other parts of the Argo that take priority.

Description.Name: Request Upgrade Quote
Description.Details: You reread the message a few times before making up your mind and hitting the <color=#028A00>REQUEST ONSITE QUOTE</color> button. A few moments later you get a response stating a representative will arrive tomorrow to inspect and quote on the cost of upgrading the Beta Pod.
